class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Share a Gem from Gemini Apps</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><p>You can share Gems from Gemini Apps for others to use and edit.</p>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Important:</strong> To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener"><u>Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</u></a>.</p>
</div>

<gkms-context-selector id="16507745"></gkms-context-selector><h2>Share a Gem</h2>

<p><strong>Important:&nbsp;</strong></p>

<div class="no-margin"><ul>
  <li>Any Gem instructions and files that you have uploaded to the Gem can be viewed by any user with access to the Gem.</li>
  <li>Any user with edit access to the Gem can also update and delete the Gem. <a href="#access_levels"><u>Learn more about Gem access levels</u></a>.</li>
  <li>NotebookLM notebooks can't be used as a source for shared Gems.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<h3><a id="share" name="share">Share with specific people</a></h3>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>Click Open Sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>Click Gems.</li>
  <li>Next to the Gem that you want to share, click Share <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA">.</li>
  <li>Enter the email address you want to share with. If you use a <a href="/accounts/answer/6250166?hl=en" rel="noopener">work or school account</a>, you can share with suggested recipients.</li>
  <li>Decide how people can use your Gem. Select one:
    <ul>
      <li>Viewer</li>
      <li>Editor</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Optional steps</strong>:
    <ul>
      <li>If you would like to add an expiration date for the user’s access, click <a href="#expiration">Add expiration</a>.</li>
      <li>In the text box, you can add a message that will be included in the notification email.</li>
      <li>If you don’t want the recipient(s) to be notified, unselect Notify people.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Click <strong>Send</strong> or <strong>Share</strong>.
    <ul>
      <li>If the Gem includes uploaded files, you’ll be asked to <a href="#share_files">share access to the files</a>.</li>
      <li>If Notify people was selected, the recipient(s) will get an email with a link to the shared Gem.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><strong>Tips:&nbsp;</strong>
<ul>
  <li>You can also follow these steps to update access levels or remove access from specific people.</li>
  <li><a href="#access_levels">Learn more about sharing levels</a>.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="share_files" name="share_files">Share access to files uploaded to the shared Gem</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p dir="ltr">If you have uploaded files to the Gem, and you have permissions to share these files, you will be asked if you want to share the file(s) with the Gem.&nbsp;</p>

<ol>
  <li>Select the level of access you want to share to the file(s):
    <ul>
      <li>Viewer</li>
      <li>Commenter</li>
      <li>Editor</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Click Share.</li>
</ol>

<p>If you have uploaded files to a Gem, don’t share the Gem with anyone who you don’t want to view the files.</p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="expiration" name="expiration">Add an expiration date</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>To add an expiration date and time to your shared Gem:</p>

<ol>
  <li>After you’ve entered the email address of the user you would like to share with, click on the user’s role&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw">&nbsp;<strong>Add expiration</strong>.</li>
  <li>Next to the expiration date and time, click Edit expiration <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/4ABPcUgldlpLZCiDerdJgbaxZL3ru3yIWDq3HKeZO35yngsVxP83Ue9IQM2e-p6bces=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/4ABPcUgldlpLZCiDerdJgbaxZL3ru3yIWDq3HKeZO35yngsVxP83Ue9IQM2e-p6bces">.</li>
  <li>Select the date when access will expire for that person or group.</li>
  <li>Select the time when access will expire for that person or group.</li>
  <li>Click <strong>Done</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="transfer_owner" name="transfer_owner">Transfer ownership of a Gem</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><strong>Important: </strong>If you transfer ownership of a Gem, the new owner will have the ability to remove your access to the Gem.</div>

  <div class="no-margin">&nbsp;</div>

  <div class="no-margin"><p>You can transfer ownership of a Gem to another person who has access to the Gem.</p>

<ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>Click Open Sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>Click Gems<strong> </strong><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk">.</li>
  <li>Next to the Gem that you want to share, click Share <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA">.</li>
  <li>Find the person who you want to transfer ownership to and click on the user’s role.
    <ul>
      <li>If you haven’t shared the Gem with this person yet, <a href="#share">complete the steps to share a Gem with a specific person</a> before transferring ownership.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Click <strong>Transfer ownership </strong><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> <strong>Yes</strong>.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>

<h3>Share a link</h3>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>Click Open Sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>Click Gems.</li>
  <li>Next to the Gem that you want to share, click Share <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Copy link <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ca8dWtVP7O7YnSVVzcV3ZWAUxGA6icNf0z9i0x8WnogmQsVoCSttIJIoI8iaBMYlu2VG=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ca8dWtVP7O7YnSVVzcV3ZWAUxGA6icNf0z9i0x8WnogmQsVoCSttIJIoI8iaBMYlu2VG">. Then paste it where you want to share, like in a messaging app or an email draft.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><strong>Tip:</strong> For other users to access the Gem through the shared link, they need access to the Gem. You can <a href="#share">give specific people access</a> or you can <a href="#general_access">change the general access of your Gem</a>.</div>


<h2>Learn more about sharing Gems</h2>
<a class="zippy" id="gems_with_files" name="gems_with_files">Sharing Gems with uploaded files</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin">Gems with uploaded files can only be shared with device files or Google Drive files. If there are other file types uploaded in the Gem’s Knowledge section, you won’t be able to share the Gem.</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="access_levels" name="access_levels">Gem access levels</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><strong>Important:</strong> Any user with edit access to a Gem can update or delete the Gem instructions and uploaded files. These changes may change Gemini’s response.</div>

  <div class="no-margin">&nbsp;</div>

  <div class="no-margin"><table class="nice-table">
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td colspan="2"><strong>Users with this access level can:</strong></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>Editor</td>
      <td>
      <ul>
        <li>Share the Gem with others</li>
        <li>Make changes to the Gem instructions and uploaded files</li>
        <li>Delete the Gem</li>
      </ul>
      </td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td>Viewer</td>
      <td>
      <ul>
        <li>Use the shared Gem</li>
        <li>View the Gem instructions and uploaded files</li>
      </ul>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="general_access" name="general_access">Change the general access for your Gem</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>You can allow broad access to your Gem. These options depend on if you’re signed in to a personal, work, or school Google Account.</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>Public: </strong>Anyone can search on Google and get access to your Gem, without signing in to their Google Account. If you use a Google Account through work or school, you may not find this option.</li>
  <li><strong>Anyone with the link:</strong> Anyone who has the link can use your Gem, without signing in to their Google Account. If you use a Google Account through work or school, you may not find this option.</li>
  <li><strong>Your organization: </strong>If you use a Google Account through work or school, anyone signed in to an account in your organization can open the Gem.</li>
  <li><strong>Private:</strong> Only people with access can open the Gem.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Work or school users: Sharing Gems outside of your organization</strong></p>

<p>Gems sharing is controlled by your organization’s Drive sharing settings. Drive sharing settings are managed by your organization’s Workspace administrator.&nbsp;<a href="https://support.google.com/a/answer/16460551?p=gems_sharing" rel="noopener"><u>Learn more about how to manage Gem sharing</u></a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="gems_drive" name="gems_drive">Shared Gems are saved in your Google Drive</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>Shared Gems are saved in a new Drive folder. Any files uploaded as part of the Gem’s uploaded files are also saved in the Drive folder.</p>

<p>If access to a Gem is removed for a user, the Gem will be removed from that user’s Google Drive.</p>

<p>To find the Gem file in Drive:</p>

<ol>
  <li>On your computer, go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>Click Open Sidebar <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/fqTyQSL82VVyKSP-iEDozGBeOLhGbqzKchkmp14SzSXMIoZnpoMTpO8vrGPx7AnbdxY2">.</li>
  <li>Click <strong>Settings and Help</strong> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Gems <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk">.</li>
  <li>Next to the Gem that you want to find in Drive, click More <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/b71eih8vpqNx3eMyEn_d3TtszjcOGDLDRz6QuqbX8o86d5-7fD7EEiW_XqlkrtZJuuva"><strong> </strong><img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw"> Locate Gem in Drive <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/xAtT3MqbqAEbvdlZqrBX7Hs_hzq1L_YMa_evnVLiDZR388j3NYgyfYiZ_GQpNsPSLg=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/xAtT3MqbqAEbvdlZqrBX7Hs_hzq1L_YMa_evnVLiDZR388j3NYgyfYiZ_GQpNsPSLg">.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="cannot_share" name="cannot_share">Work or school users: Why can’t I share a Gem?</a>

<div>
  <div class="no-margin"><p>If you don’t find the Share <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA">&nbsp;option, you may not be able to share the Gem. There are two common reasons why you can’t share a Gem:</p>

<ul>
  <li><strong>The Gem includes a file type that’s not supported for sharing.&nbsp;</strong><a href="#gems_with_files">Learn more about sharing Gems with uploaded files</a>.</li>
  <li><strong>Your organization has disabled Gem sharing.&nbsp;</strong>Your Workspace administrator can turn Gem sharing on or off. Contact your administrator to learn more.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
